nodes.label: TUI Install-Scope Threading & Double-Press Quit Guard (S-161 / 0.5.2 impl A)
nodes.rationale: Threads the [g]/[p] scope toggle through TUI install paths into svcInstall({global}) without modifying core install semantics, and guards against accidental single-keystroke quit while filtering via an armed double-press q.
